review_locator: PMCID:PMC3155743, Sensing of viral nucleic acids by RIG-I: from translocation to translation
primary_title: The structural basis of 5-prime triphosphate double-stranded RNA recognition by RIG-I C-terminal domain
decision_basis: Primary structural, biochemical and cell-based evidence supports 5-prime-ppp blunt-ended dsRNA recognition and RIG-I activation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve short blunt-ended dsRNA, 5-prime-triphosphate, RIG-I CTD/end-recognition and ATP/CARD activation context; no generic dsRNA or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4107945, Pattern Recognition and Signaling Mechanisms of RIG-I and MDA5
primary_title: Cryo-EM Structures of MDA5-dsRNA Filaments at Different Stages of ATP Hydrolysis
decision_basis: Primary structural and cell-based evidence supports long-dsRNA MDA5 filament assembly and activation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve long dsRNA, internal cooperative filament assembly, ATP-hydrolysis and MAVS-signaling context; distinguish MDA5 from RIG-I end recognition; no terminal-TF inference.
